1.web: My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.
1.asv: My heart is fixed, O God; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises, even with my glory.

2.web: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.
2.asv: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake right early.

3.web: I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.
3.asv: I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah, among the peoples; And I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

4.web: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
4.asv: For thy lovingkindness is great above the heavens; And thy truth reacheth unto the skies.

5.web: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.
5.asv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens, And thy glory above all the earth.

6.web: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
6.asv: That thy beloved may be delivered, Save with thy right hand, and answer us.

7.web: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
7.asv: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult; I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

8.web: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.
8.asv: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.

9.web: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”
9.asv: Moab is my washpot; Upon Edom will I cast my shoe; Over Philistia will I shout.

10.web: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who has led me to Edom?
10.asv: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who hath led me unto Edom?

11.web: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.
11.asv: Hast not thou cast us off, O God? And thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.

12.web: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.
12.asv: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.

13.web: Through God, we will do valiantly. For it is he who will tread down our enemies.
13.asv: Through God we shall do valiantly: For he it is that will tread down our adversaries.
